correctness.rationale: For positive feedback ratios the three environmental equations are logistic with affine forcing by x and y, hence d(logit(n_i))/dt equals the forcing. Coefficients a=(1+theta12)/(2(1+theta1)) and b=(1+theta12)/(2(1+theta2)) cancel both strategy variables identically in logit(n12)-a*logit(n1)-b*logit(n2), giving constant kappa=a+b-1 and exact I(t)=I(0)+kappa*t. Independent symbolic simplification verified the derivative and exact zero at the claimed resonance theta12=(theta1+theta2+2theta1*theta2)/(2+theta1+theta2). If kappa nonzero, any compact forward-invariant subset of fully interior environmental states would bound I, contradiction; one-sided logit bounds yield the precise finite-time oriented union of epsilon-boundary neighborhoods, not selection of an individual face. For theta1=1, theta2=3, theta12=5/3, delta=1/2 and the given two payoff matrices, the exact curve (x,y,n1,n2,n12)=(1/2,1/4,1-u,1-u,u) satisfies the five equations for every 0<u<1. Payoffs and strategies need not be stationary for the drift identity.
